import re
import sys

values = {}

for match in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z]+|\d+)", sys.stdin.read()):
    name, rhs = match.groups()
    values[name] = int(rhs) if rhs.isdigit() else values[rhs]

order = "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p TMP".split()
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
